title: AAA Services must be configured to disable accounts when the accounts are in violation of organizational policy.
check_content:
Verify AAA Services is configured to disable accounts when the accounts are in violation of organizational policy.

If AAA Services is not configured to disable accounts when the accounts are in violation of organizational policy, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure AAA Services to disable accounts when the accounts are in violation of organizational policy.
VulnDiscussion: Disabling expired, inactive, or otherwise anomalous accounts supports the concepts of least privilege and least functionality, which reduce the attack surface of the system.
